description: This file contains the implementation of the UniXcoder model, a neural network for code understanding and generation, including classes for tokenization, sequence generation, and beam search decoding.

classes.name: UniXcoder
classes.description: A neural network model class for code understanding and generation based on the RoBERTa architecture, with methods for tokenization, decoding, and sequence generation.

classes.name: Beam
classes.description: A helper class implementing beam search for sequence decoding in the UniXcoder model.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the UniXcoder model, loads pretrained tokenizer and model, sets configurations, and registers buffers.

methods.name: set_seed
methods.description: Sets random seeds for reproducibility across random, numpy, and torch.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Converts input strings into token IDs with support for different modes and padding.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Converts token IDs back into human-readable strings.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Computes token and sentence embeddings from input token IDs.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates sequences using beam search based on input source IDs.
